The four new ones test the completeness CLAIM rather than the fields' presence: the population is prior-HOLDINGS not rows; a restricted run can never read complete; an empty day does not read complete (without the len(pop) > 0 guard, 0 + 0 == 0 satisfies the identity and publishes complete over nothing, which is the shape a silent upstream failure takes); a duplicated account row breaks complete. mutant.description: Round 2's claim is COMPLETENESS, not a value, so the mutant attacks completeness rather than arithmetic: ONE account that held 15 positions at t-1 (0010023253) was dropped from the landed 2026-09-25 daily partition, 7,540 rows to 7,539, re-landed through the same ETag-verified primitive. The MANIFEST WAS DELIBERATELY LEFT UNTOUCHED, so it went on asserting complete=True over a partition that was now short -- which is precisely the silent failure the four completeness fields exist to make visible, and the thing a check that trusted the manifest would have missed.
mutant.expected: E2-AC1 FAIL on a missing account while the manifest still claims complete, then PASS after the producer re-lands the partition
mutant.observed: Under the mutant: 'gold rows at 2026-09-25: 7539 | missing 1 | duplicated 0 | manifest {... 'complete': True} / E2-AC1 FAIL / exit 1'. The check reported the missing account AND printed the manifest's contradicting claim beside it. After the producer's own re-run of date=2026-09-25: 7,540 rows, missing 0, E2-AC1 PASS / exit 0; E2-AC2 re-run PASS, confirming no other partition was disturbed.

determinism.method: Two independent instruments on the same population, plus a cross-round regression: (a) the 557-day dry run and the 557-day upload; (b) date=2026-09-25 produced twice more, in the mutant restore and in a prior single-day run; (c) the vectorized core checked against the round-1 committed value for the thread account.
determinism.observed: Every run of date=2026-09-25 produced 7,540 rows with the identical census {OK 6650, NO-PRIOR-HOLDINGS 881, NON-POSITIVE-BASE 6, ALL-HOLDINGS-EXCLUDED 3} and identical counts (6341/6338/3, complete True). All 557 partitions reported complete=True, 0 days not computed, 0 SKIP/ABSENT/EMPTY notes and 0 tracebacks in the run log. CROSS-ROUND: the vectorized core reproduces round 1's committed thread value 0.004612117916 to a delta of 8.67e-19 -- NOT bit-identical, because summing per-account groups reassociates the floating-point additions, and about 1e-10 of the 1e-9 tolerance E1-AC1 grades on. Stated rather than rounded away.
